newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian BTC to bid for second GSM licence.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian BTC to bid for second GSM licence.

text.p: The Bulgarian Telecommunication Company (BTC) said on Tuesday it planned to participate together with a foreign partner in the operation of a planned second GSM network.
BTC chairman Mihail Danov, referring to Bulgaria's proposed sale of a 25-percent stake in BTC, told a news conference the company's value would be enhanced if it had a GSM licence.
The Bulgarian Posts and Communications Committee is due to prepare its proposal to the government for launching a tender for the second GSM operator within three months.
In a separate development, Bulgaria's first GSM operator Mobiltel, which started operating last September, is seeking to sell its own licence.
The BTC, which expects to attract the interest of big telecom firms in its stake sale, owes a total of some $20 million to foreign telecommunications companies, Danov said.
He said part of BTC debts were to Russia's state-owned Rostelefon, totalling $8 million.
